summary: Creative Medical Technology Holdings (CELZ) filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026, disclosing a Stock Purchase Agreement with Creative Acquisition Corp. (CAC) to buy 4,000,000 BioDefense, Inc. shares for $200,000 cash plus 1,000,000 CELZ common shares. Post-close, CELZ holds 16,000,000 BioDefense shares (80%) and CAC retains 4,000,000 shares (20%). CELZ CEO Timothy Warbington controls CAC, making this a related-party transaction. CELZ shares were issued privately under Section 4(a)(2). No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed.
